description: Payee Check: before paying an address, is it a known x402 seller? Screens it against OFAC's sanctioned crypto addresses and matches it against the payout addresses of ~35k listed x402 endpoints: KNOWN_SELLER (which services, 30-day calls and payers), SHARED_ADDRESS (platform/facilitator wallet) or UNKNOWN. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: GET https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/market/payee, $0.002 via x402.)
